reviews.text: This was my first visit. My previous grooming salon closed down, so I looked at various reviews and called. They were able to accommodate me on the same day, so I requested a shampoo (carbonated water) and cut. There were several shampoo options to choose from, and the groomer listened attentively to my concerns and assured me that they would do everything to minimize any stress on my dog. I was worried about my dog, who hates having his face groomed, so I kept checking the clock every hour after dropping him off, but they called to say it was finished. When I went to pick him up, I was so grateful for the result, which was exactly what I wanted. They even took pictures during the shampoo, a commemorative photo at the end, and a grooming checklist. Their thoughtfulness and dog-first approach were amazing. I look forward to using their services again and will make another reservation.

I opted for the grooming service. I appreciated being able to choose from several types of shampoo tailored to my dog. The grooming was excellent, and they accommodated my last-minute reservation. I will definitely use their services again in the future. The staff were all very polite and helpful.

This is a shop where I can always entrust my dog ​​to them with confidence, as they always do a thorough job. 😊
Since it's the hot season, they kindly accepted my request for a neat, short trim, and they did a very cute job. I appreciate the detailed reports they gave me about my dog's condition and any concerns during the grooming process.

As it was my dog's birthday month, they also gave us homemade apple 🍎 cookies, which made both my dog ​​and me very happy.

This was our first time getting a shampoo treatment, and when I picked her up, her fur was so fluffy and she had a cute ribbon on her, making her look stylish! 🩷
Thank you so much! 😊 I'll definitely be back! ✨

My usual salon was fully booked, so I searched online and made an appointment for my desired date.

The cut was exactly as I wanted, and what I particularly loved was the shampoo 🥰 My dog ​​has fine, fluffy fur, but for the first time, it's been smooth and shiny ♡ I'd like to request their services again next time. Thank you so much for the photos after the grooming! I'm so happy I was able to get her looking so beautiful before her birthday.

This was our first visit for our puppy's second grooming session. The staff explained everything very carefully, and the grooming was done beautifully.

The scent of the mud shampoo lingered subtly for quite a while.

Our whole family is very happy with the cut this time.

We look forward to seeing you again next time.

This was my first time using their service.
All the staff were very friendly and gave me a thorough consultation about how I wanted my pet to look, so I felt at ease leaving my pet there.
They did such a cute job, I'm very happy with the result.
Since it's nearby, I'd like to use their service again.
